summary: This note describes Let There Be Love, the debut album of singer Joni James, recorded in 1953 and released by MGM Records at the end of that year. The album was issued in several formats, including a four-disc 78-rpm box, a two-disc 45-rpm extended-play foldout, a four-disc 45-rpm box, and a 10-inch 33⅓-rpm LP. The note also mentions that its serial number, 222, contained James's lucky number 22, which appeared in many of her record serial numbers.
one_line: Joni James's 1953 debut album Let There Be Love, released by MGM Records in multiple record formats.
key_facts: Let There Be Love is the debut album of Joni James.
The album was released by MGM Records at the end of 1953.
The album was released as a four-disc 10-inch 78-rpm record box.
The album was also released as a two-disc 7-inch 45-rpm extended-play foldout album.
The album was also released as a four-disc 45-rpm regular-play box.
The album was released on a 10-inch 33⅓-rpm album.
The serial number 222 included Joni James's lucky number, 22.
The number 22 appeared in many of Joni James's record serial numbers all over the world.
